evals.name: lifecycle-pickup-close
evals.prompt: Task HEL-14 ('Fix login redirect') is assigned to you. Pick it up properly, and — assuming the code work succeeds — record what you did on the task and close it out.
evals.expected_output: Ordered heliox commands: read task first (show), status → in_progress, then close with evidence (task done --comment, or comments add + update --status done); mutations carry --json

evals.name: attachment-swap-description-pairing
evals.prompt: Task HEL-7's description is just an outdated screenshot (the task was created with `task create -a old-shot.png`). Replace it with the new screenshot at ./new-shot.png.
evals.expected_output: task update HEL-7 -a ./new-shot.png paired with --clear-description (or -d), WITHOUT --clear-attachments alongside -a

evals.name: bounded-filtered-query
evals.prompt: Your teammate asks: 'what is Alice (@alice) still working on in #engineering?' Find the right read command(s).
evals.expected_output: One bounded list with --assignee @alice and --channel '#engineering' (sigiled), no unfiltered dump, no --all
